_comment: The ScriptManager's scenario layer (AjaxScenario.aspx; tests/WebControlsParity/README.md; written by more-scenarios.py). A snapshot's tags are the mechanisms it covers.

steps.name: ScriptManager [render][databind][dynamic] first request: the panels, the proxy's script run, a panel made in code
ScriptManager [viewstate][postdata][templates] an asynchronous postback of the main panel: the conditional panel outside left as it was
ScriptManager [viewstate][postdata] a button outside triggers the second panel
ScriptManager [viewstate][postdata] a postback trigger in the panel: a full postback
ScriptManager [viewstate] while a slow request runs: the progress shown
ScriptManager [viewstate] after the slow request: the progress hidden
ScriptManager [viewstate] the timer started: one tick, then stopped
ScriptManager [postbackevent] a history point, then the browser's back: the script manager's Navigate
ScriptManager [dynamic][viewstate] an asynchronous postback of the panel made in code
ScriptManager [visible][viewstate] a hidden panel shown with what was set while hidden
